name: push ups
description: Standard push ups. Keep your back flat and lower until your chest is just above the floor.

name: bodyweight squats
description: Feet shoulder-width apart, sit back into your heels, knees tracking over toes.

name: burpees
description: Squat, kick legs back, push up, jump them in, jump up. One fluid rep.

name: plank
description: Hold a push-up position on your forearms. Keep your core tight and body in a straight line.

name: lunges
description: Step forward with one leg until both knees are bent at a 90-degree angle. Alternate legs.

name: jumping jacks
description: Jump with legs spread and hands touching overhead, then return to a standing position.

name: mountain climbers
description: In a plank position, quickly alternate bringing your knees toward your chest as if running.

name: glute bridges
description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat. Lift your hips toward the ceiling and squeeze.
